subject: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@org-consult.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation

Team —

Following our sync last week, I put together a first-pass package for the upcoming performance cycle. The goal is to align timeline, manager-facing comms, and a short risk mitigation checklist for sensitive roles. Please review the attached timeline and comms script and flag any items you want pulled into the Exec note.

Key asks:
- Markus: confirm gating dates for calibration and calibration attendees (we need two extra weeks for PL1/PL2 roles).
- Lauren: review the manager comms script for tone and legal-safe phrasing; mark any lines that require legal review.
- Grace: validate the privacy/exception routing flow (attached as a form).

Attachments (v1): review_timeline_v1.xlsx, manager_comms_scripts.docx, privacy_exception_form.pdf

I kept the timeline conservative to leave a buffer for escalation and procurement sign-offs. If we want a tighter window, we'll need to accept a partial stagger for Sales and Platform teams.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of People & Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@org-consult.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation

Vanessa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a pass on the timeline:
- Calibration: suggest moving manager calibration one week earlier and adding a separate 90-minute session for "privileged" roles (infra, security, researcher leads). That prevents last-minute changes.
- Deadlines: procurement has two blackout dates in late Sep (cloud credits review); we should avoid escalation windows then.
- Attendees: I'll nominate leads for calibration in a separate doc by EOD Monday.

I also added line comments to the timeline spreadsheet where we need extra approvals. Happy to sync 20m if helpful.

-MK

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@org-consult.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation

Vanessa / Markus —

I reviewed the manager_comms_scripts.docx and made suggested edits focused on minimizing legal exposure. High-level:
- Removed language promising specific salary outcomes; replaced with "outcomes and calibration may affect compensation recommendations."
- Added a short paragraph on how to handle employee questions about data retained for reviews and where to route privacy exceptions.
- Flagged the paragraph about forced distribution — we should avoid any absolute phrasing.

I've attached inline comments in the docx. On the privacy form: Grace, one ask — can we add a checkbox for "requires Legal review"? Many exceptions do and it will speed routing.

Also: for the Exec note, propose a 2-sentence preamble that emphasizes fairness and that we have a documented exception path. Happy to draft if helpful.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, People Ops (Comp & Performance)
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@org-consult.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation

Team —

Quick privacy/risk notes after reviewing privacy_exception_form.pdf:
- Add a required field for "business justification" and link to the relevant policy section (I inserted a reference line).
- Checkbox for "requires Legal review" (as Lauren suggested) — I implemented this on the draft.
- For sensitive roles (SRE, Key Custodians), exceptions must route through Legal and Security simultaneously; that's a change from last year and needs Exec approval.

I attached a redlined privacy_exception_form.pdf and a short process flow in the timeline spreadsheet. If we're adding a simultaneous legal+security path, we'll need a communication to teams explaining why and who to contact — legal@redwood.com and security_ops@redwood.com were added as contacts.

Also noting Acme (our pilot customer) asked for a copy of the comms and a high-level timeline by Aug 7 — flagged as an external deliverable.

- Grace
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: privacy_exception_form_redline.pdf (form)]

From: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops@org-consult.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual evaluation package: timeline, comms, and risk mitigation

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the package and the quick iterations. A few pragmatic suggestions from our side before you finalize:

1) Staggered rollout: run Sales and Support on a 2-week lag from Core/Infra to reduce lost productivity during calibration.
2) Manager scripts: open with a "what we cannot promise" paragraph and keep bullets for FAQs. We provided a short one-page FAQ (attached) managers can paste into Slack.
3) External recipients: for pilot customers like Acme, provide a sanitized version of the Exec note (no names, no calibration details) — see attached sample.

We also included a simple Gantt export (review_timeline_v1_gantt.png) you can drop into the all-hands slide.

If you want, we can incorporate your edits and return a final package by Aug 9 for Exec sign-off.

Best,
Claire Raymond
Engagement Lead, PeopleOps Consulting
[Attachment: manager_faq_onepager.pdf (pdf), review_timeline_v1_gantt.png (image)]
